decisionsTitle: The design system is binding: colours, icons and primitives have guards with a ratchet
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-10:** «I need a design system so we can be consistent in terms of colours, icons, components», and «component-based, vibe-coder friendly and easy to use».

**What existed, and what did not.** The pieces were there: the tokens in `src/theme/brand.ts` (every hex of the site, with the AA pairs and the logo blue pinned by `brand.test.ts`), the two icon registries (`src/modules/events/ui/glyphs.ts` for public pages, `src/shared/ui/action-icons.ts` for the backoffice, §318, §521), the house primitives (`ButtonLink`, the `GlyphButton` family, `SubmitButton`, `GlyphChip`, `ChipLink`) and the design page `/admin/design`. Nothing FAILED when a page drifted: a raw hex in `sx`, an icon imported straight from `@mui/icons-material`, a bare MUI `Button` where `GlyphButton` exists.

**Decision.** Three source-scanning vitest guards in `tests/unit/design/`, each reading `src/` with the TypeScript parser (comments, regular expressions and the migrations are never read), one shared walk in `scan.ts`:

- `colour-literals.test.ts` refuses `rgb(`, `rgba(`, `hsl(`, `hsla(` and a `#` hex in a string or template literal outside `brand.ts` (the heuristic is documented in the test: not preceded by a word character, `&`, `/` or `=`, and with a digit in it, so an anchor is not a colour).
- `icon-imports.test.ts` refuses any import from `@mui/icons-material` outside an icon registry — `action-icons.ts`, `glyphs.ts`, or a file whose name says it is a name-to-glyph table (`section-glyphs.ts`, `TeamLinkGlyph.tsx`); `isIconRegistry` is the one definition.
- `primitives.test.ts` refuses `Button`, `IconButton` and `Chip` imported from MUI in `src/app/**` and an area's `ui/**`: use ButtonLink / GlyphButton / GlyphChip. `src/shared/`, where the primitives are written, is not scanned.

**The ratchet.** Today's offenders are in one file, `guards-allowlist.ts`, each with a reason (13 colours: scrims, brand colours of third parties, the pages that render outside the theme; 124 direct icon imports; 92 bare MUI buttons and chips). A new offender fails its test; a listed file that was fixed fails as a stale entry; and the list's length must equal `PINNED`, so a shrink is a deliberate edit of two numbers in one reviewed file. No big-bang migration: a file leaves the list when it is next touched, and the numbers only go down. The areas the owner's brief named as clean (the members' shop, the team editors, the design page) are fixed, not listed: the team editors now use `GlyphButton` (new registry names `moveUp` and `moveDown`) instead of MUI's `IconButton` and a direct icon file.

**The system, in files.** Tokens: `src/theme/brand.ts`. Registries: `src/modules/events/ui/glyphs.ts`, `src/shared/ui/action-icons.ts`. Primitives: `src/shared/ui/ButtonLink.tsx`, `GlyphButton*.tsx`, `SubmitButton.tsx`, `ConfirmSubmitButton.tsx`, `src/modules/events/ui/GlyphChip.tsx`. The page: `/admin/design`. The guards: `tests/unit/design/`. `docs/VIBECODING.md` names all of it in one line.

**Refused.** An ESLint plugin (a dependency, and a second place for the rules to live: a vitest scan like the house's others costs nothing to install and runs in `yarn check`). A `// eslint-disable`-style inline escape: the allowlist is one file, reviewed, and an escape in the middle of a component is invisible to the next reader. A big-bang migration of the 229 listed files: too much risk for no visitor-facing gain. The words rules catalogue (`src/modules/design/rules.ts`) was not on the branch when it was written, so the guards are named in the tests and in `VIBECODING.md` only.
changelogLine: - **The design system is binding** — colours, icons and buttons or chips are now checked by three tests in `yarn check`: a new raw colour, a direct `@mui/icons-material` import or a bare MUI `Button` / `IconButton` / `Chip` fails, and today's exceptions sit in one list that can only shrink. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: No source file under `src/` carries a colour literal (a `#` hex, `rgb(`, `rgba(`, `hsl(`, `hsla(`) outside `src/theme/brand.ts` except the files listed with a reason in `tests/unit/design/guards-allowlist.ts`; the list can only shrink (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

No source file imports `@mui/icons-material` outside an icon registry except the files listed with a reason in the same allowlist, and a listed file that no longer offends fails the test until it is removed from the list (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

No page under `src/app/` and no component under an area's `ui/` imports MUI's `Button`, `IconButton` or `Chip` outside the reviewed list: public buttons are `ButtonLink`, `GlyphButton` or `SubmitButton` with the 44-pixel tap target (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
